storage: New private captures and PCM on the external cache volume, mount identity checked; no internal-disk fallback

capture_method.post_gain_boundary: Bounded copies at the validated function return, before workspace reuse; first eight also checked against the former observation point
capture_method.per_envelope: Prefix native replay checked against valid captured fields, with zero-mantissa exponent representation canonicalized

local_replay.entry: cfg(test) child of hfadjust, calls production hfgain::adjust for Off/OffWithBoost/On
local_replay.normalized_noise_representation: Undo the native in-place assembly conversion; onset-inactive stored noise power is converted to amplitude for comparison only

reference_behavior_model.source: Fixed from captured tone and validated native operations before synthetic holdout execution; no error-minimizing fit; revision 2 adds the separately identified square-root conversion zero threshold; additional holdouts follow this freeze.

pcm_comparison.band_definition: 4096-sample Hann STFT; 12 kHz inclusive to 18 kHz exclusive

validation.repair: Place the test module beneath hfadjust, using the existing layer owner; no audit exemption added

limits: Limited to the specified runtime, selected tone/music AUs and constructed cases; not a codec-wide conformance claim
Native reference replays are bit exact; local Rust and diagnostic model comparisons report numeric residuals separately
The normalized gain-domain noise comparison on onset envelopes does not imply audible noise injection
Reference startup and incomplete-capture failures were excluded and retained locally; they are not evidence of unsupported bitstreams
Current option only adds boost; the reference group/hard limits, floor and mantissa-zeroing rule remain outside production
Whole PCM residuals from phase, preflattening, synthesis-generation clocks and other stages remain open; no >=18 kHz reference low-pass was adopted
